why: 0.1.415: the owner authorized re-cutting the marks so the frozen snapshots match the live component again. The named parallels went gold and heavier (equator 3->5, tropics 2->3.5) and the dark rule ladder was raised; a self-contained mark carries resolved literals, so it cannot pick either up on its own. Also fixes build_brand.py resolving the DARK block against the LIGHT palette, which would have stamped the dark cover with the light gold at 1.4:1.
